implementation.preparation: Preflight retains prior capability/right/range/loan/pin checks. One private owner allocates empty admitted mapping node and snapshot capacity outside MEMORY_OBJECTS, with no frame identity/borrow or pin across the factory interval; existing caller root retained. Final captured object/size and complete admission revalidation precede fill, relink and existing pin acquisition.
implementation.publication: No allocating BTreeMap mapping-record insertion or frame-vector growth under MEMORY_OBJECTS. Table walk and prefix rollback keep prior serialization; unused/snapshot disposal leaves local memory/table guards. No new unlocked table walk, root, capacity, deadline or public grammar/ABI.
implementation.retirement: Confirmed leaf rollback retains exact published-prefix descriptor in original detached mapping node inside existing pin through invalidation/scratch completion. Explicit node disposal precedes pin decrement/backing release. Unmap keeps its live record until all proofs; revocation carries detached node in same pin. Whole-object receipts retain admitted nodes/peer leases on uncertainty/abandonment; physical success permits node free, then exact peer-lease completion.
